status: protocol frozen before new test scoring
daily_split: global calendar boundaries, completed training labels strictly before training boundary; no missing IDs; positive purchases only
instacart_split: original-customer order boundaries shared by every product pair; observable baskets only; target is recorded relative same-item days, not calendar days
cohort: daily: at least three purchases before training end; Instacart pair: at least six item purchases before original-customer training end; no future eligibility filter
origins: all causal sliding training windows; first origin per series per later phase, chosen without future outcomes; incomplete targets retained for survival likelihood
neural_backend: PyTorch 2.2.2 CUDA, float32, minibatches held on host; no Keras fits
headline_loss: MAE in original days; no percentile clipping; direct and residual parameterization available to all recurrent comparators
controller: training-only mutual information with redundancy penalty; actual temporal encoder search; independent early-stop and input-selection phases; repeated per seed
stacking: nonnegative simplex MAE linear program using stack_fit only; no arbitrary 40/400/.5% rules
baselines: neural Weibull AFT with incomplete intervals
Rebuilt NN MSE and matched MAE
ablations: fixed vs selected inputs on all three
no customer groups: complete-system refit on each seed; exact cached identity if chosen K already zero
multistep: clean positive purchase-day events, five horizon-specific metrics; unified PyTorch Transformer with both direct and recursive forecasts; matching origins
statistics: original-customer resampling for MAE/RMSE/MedAE and signed bias; all predeclared comparator pairs; Holm adjustment; no DM claim for unordered customer outcomes
costs: measured training, selection, inference, parameters and artifact sizes; asymmetric early/late costs as explicitly hypothetical ratios, no measured marketing profit
paper_gate: Do not edit manuscript until coding, audited reruns, and result aggregation complete. Never claim a selected variant wins unless actual frozen-test results show it.

hardware_amendment_before_primary_traini.basis: training-only throughput benchmark; no selection or test metrics used

sensitivity_scope: Graph and log-loss grids replace/refit the encoder and refit full-system simplex weights, holding the other fitted members fixed; diagnostic, not full five-member loss retuning.

pre_analysis_comparator_amendment.basis: review asks for strong simple baselines; no new test metrics have been scored or inspected
rules: independently validation-selected window mean and median
